summary: Refined the Tikbalang walk motion in tikbalang/init.luau with grounded support shifting, squared sine lift envelopes for arc spacing, subtle torso staging lean, and secondary head/torso settling without altering root motion or bone structure.
expectedEffect: Improved silhouette readability, weighted stride support, and natural foot lift timing during locomotion.
